bench: LTL pallet with liftgate; air freight and broker from overseas
bench_sens: air-ride, white-glove, inside delivery (vacuum instruments, X-ray sources)
floor: crated, LTL or air-ride, riggers into the lab
floor_sens: air-ride, white-glove, riggers into the lab, chiller and gas fittings
floor_heavy: 1-2 t frame: riggers out, air-ride, riggers in
machine: 2-5 t machine: riggers out, flatbed or air-ride, riggers in; overseas a container
machine_light: a crated robot or AMR, 100-300 kg
vlm: a 9 m VLM taken down, trucked in pieces and re-erected by certified fitters

freight_source: estimates anchored on LTL rates and machine-moving guides (see the comment above FREIGHT)
lead_source: assumed: a week for a dealer to crate and release, two for a refurbisher or an auction's close and removal window; a week across the US, six from overseas (ocean, customs, inland); riggers booked a week ahead for machines
extra_com_source: assumed: half a week for a bench tool, 1.5-2 for vacuum and X-ray instruments and machines (a service engineer's visit, calibration, licence transfer), 6 for LPBF and DED (the maker's recommissioning and parameter requalification)
p_fault_source: assumed per condition (1 in 20 refurbished with a warranty, 1 in 10 refurbished or warranted, 1 in 5 tested, 3 in 10 'used' with nothing said, 1 in 2 as-is); weighted by each station's listings
refurb_source: assumed by class: 3 weeks and 10 % of new for bench tools, 6-8 weeks and 15 % for vacuum and X-ray instruments (a source, a pump, a detector), 6 weeks and 10 % for machines
market_rule: >= 5 listings that fit, >= 2 in North America, >= 1 priced
